pythonFunction.name: get_active_appointments
pythonFunction.description:
Lists the customer's upcoming appointments that are not cancelled. Needs an identified caller.
Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and appointments (appointment_id, type, slot, status).
